aspectRatio: 8:5 source art rendered as full-bleed cover inside a 1:1 selected-day card
rendering: resolution-independent 1200x750 SVG event artwork; no low-resolution sprite-sheet scaling in the calendar UI

rules.rotation: deterministic by school date when a category has two variants
rules.placement: Selected-day artwork fills the card. The translucent information panel is always centered both vertically and horizontally.
rules.schedulePriority: No School and Half Day remain independently visible when another event shares the date.
rules.multiEventHandling: One or two items use a single-column detail list. Three or more items switch to a compact two-column tile grid, with lunch kept as one full-width footer row.
rules.visualCoverage: Every recognized class special and every posted event has a mapped high-resolution category; unmatched posted events fail open to school-event.svg rather than showing a blank card.
rules.duplicateHandling: A class special already represented by an event on the same date is not repeated in the detail panel.
